# che168-api-examples

> Code examples (curl, Python, JavaScript, PHP) for reading Che168 used-car listings (China) through apiauto.space, a read-only REST API. Base URL https://api.apiauto.space/v1, header X-API-Key, market=cn. A free one-day demo key (100 requests) comes from the Telegram bot https://t.me/apiautospace_bot?start=demo. Not affiliated with Che168 or Autohome.

Key facts:

- Market: `cn` = Che168. Record ids look like `che168:60385167`.
- Endpoints: GET /v1/cars (filters brand, model, trim, year_min, year_max, price_min, price_max, price_usd_min, price_usd_max, mileage_max, fuel, transmission, body_type, has_photos, is_active, q; sort; cursor pagination; limit up to 100, 20 on the demo), GET /v1/cars/{id}, GET /v1/changes (added, disappeared, price_drop, price_up since a moment), GET /v1/references/{brands,models,dictionaries,markets}, GET /v1/usage.
- Prices are in CNY and in US dollars at the ECB daily rate. Che168 listings have no VIN: `vin` is null.
- Paid plans count returned cars; the demo counts data requests. References, usage and photos are free.
- Server-side only: CORS is off.
- Client libraries: `pip install apiauto-space` (https://github.com/apiauto-space/apiauto-python), `npm i apiauto` (https://github.com/apiauto-space/apiauto-js), `composer require apiauto/apiauto` (https://github.com/apiauto-space/apiauto-php), `go get github.com/apiauto-space/apiauto-go` (https://github.com/apiauto-space/apiauto-go).
